violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

Chicken was observed held at (113) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

Working containers of (dry and liquid ingredients ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The presence of (fruit flies ) is not controlled as evidenced by (live activity ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The following equipment observed in poor repair: 1.deli display has broken glass cover 2.cold water handle missing from prep sink Equipment must be maintained in good repair and/or proper adjustment New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep table shelves, equipment shelves, rice cooker table shelf ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
The ceiling in the (3 bay sink and counter area) area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
The (walls ) in the (kitchen ) area is in poor repair. Observed holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

The door to the outside, located in the (kitchen ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the (food storage shelves) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 04/22/2025

The floors in kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue, food debris, and/or grease. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025
